Chapter 6563: Can This Spear Slay An Immortal?

Chapter 6563: Can This Spear Slay An Immortal?

The weapon turned out to be a spear with a murderous intent meant for immortals. It didn’t seem interested in killing anything else for they were unqualified. An immortal looming above the firmaments would be struck down all the same.

Spectators saw overlapping images of the spear. However, they no longer dared to look straight at it since its light alone could pierce their eyes.

It appeared to be forged from refined bronze; its tip sharpened to an unimaginable degree. Upon closer inspection, it must be made from a celestial crystal existing before the start of time.

All powers and matters were compressed together under the greatest force and heat to form this piece of primordial metal. It merely had a bronze luster, hence the confusion.

Under Chengtian’s grasp, the spear could pierce through Three Immortals and reach external worlds or even the high heaven.

“Immortal Killer.” The confident ghost took one step backward. Seeing this dreadful weapon for the second time startled him.

Other overlords had a serious expression as well. Meanwhile, participants of the old wars were scared out of their mind.

This was his strongest weapon and had saved him numerous times before. His three masters crafted it for him specifically. Because of this, he could exert its true potential and flow his dao through it.

Cultivators fortunate enough to find an immortal-grade weapon couldn’t truly use it. Only immortals had enough power to do so.

There was a great gap between an overlord and an immortal. Thus, overlords couldn’t do so either, let alone something crafted by three immortals. Therefore, Immortal Killer was unique and perfect for Chengtian.

Therefore, some believed Chengtian was considered the strongest below the immortal realm because of Immortal Killer, not his cultivation.

“Can it kill an immortal?” An overlord asked.

This question couldn’t be answered but it should have zero issue killing an overlord.

“How does it compare to Calamitous Edge?” Another wondered.

People couldn’t help comparing the two weapons because Calamitous Edge was the most famous in Three Immortals.

“No chance.” One overlord said.

“One can kill a lost immortal, the other can slay tribulations.” A wise cultivator concluded.

Which immortal would dare to test themselves against these weapons? Perhaps Immortal Killer but not Calamitous Edge.

Moreover, Calamitous Edge aimed for the high heaven itself, not just immortals. This alone made it clear which was superior.

“How many thrusts can you survive?” Chengtian pointed his spear at the opponent.

Although the ghost’s yin aura engulfed all the dimensions and served as a barrier, his throat still felt a sharp prick.

Alas, if this weapon alone could force him to back down, he wouldn’t have reached this level in the first place.

“We’ll see.” He became one with the yin and the shadows. Space had plenty of darkness so this was an advantageous location for him; the yin affinity multiplied through the dimensions.

They poured into him and strengthened his armor, making it seem to be alive.

“Falling Immortal!” Chengtian moved swiftly. Even overlords could only see remnant images.

This speed was of the immortal level, capable of knocking immortals down from their lofty thrones.

“Creation of Desires!” The ghost understood its potency and roared, releasing his desires.

Space was boundless and he separated himself from the battlefield, existing away from Three Immortals in an unreachable realm.

Unfortunately, the spear traveled faster than his technique.
